headline.phenotype_label: Metabolically young, cardiovascularly exposed · Iron-depleted · Atopic · Under-recovered
headline.voice: Peer, performance-framed. Aayush is exceptionally disciplined and motivated by capability and how he looks, not by fear. Every lever below is tied to his own stated goal: better cardio, less fatigue, sharper mind. Two items go to a physician first.

goal_alignment.his_words: Better cardio, less fatigue and higher sharpness.
goal_alignment.how_protocol_serves_it: His #1 goal (cardio) IS the single biggest lever on his lipids AND his early-insulin signal — so the medicine and the goal are the same thing. 'Less fatigue' maps directly to the iron workup + extending sleep from 6h to 7h. 'Sharper mind' maps to fixing the afternoon crash via sleep, Zone-2, and lowering the 80+ daily stress load.

biological_age_trajectory.adherence_assumed: 85%+ — his discipline is a top-decile asset
biological_age_trajectory.method: Bio-age is already 3.9y younger than calendar and PhenoAge does not 'see' his lipids/iron, so the headline number moves only modestly. The real wins (ApoB, ferritin, HDL, HOMA-IR, fatigue) live OUTSIDE the PhenoAge inputs — which is exactly why we read the full panel. Day-90 target reflects small RDW + hsCRP gains as iron and recovery improve.

root_attack_pillars.name: Pillar 1 — Lower ApoB, raise HDL (offset the inherited Lp(a))
anchor_interventions: Zone-2 cardio 150 min/week (his own goal) — the HDL + insulin lever
Soluble fibre to 30-40g/day via oats, chia, psyllium, dal (not vegetables he won't eat)
Swap saturated for unsaturated fat: cut ghee, halve egg-yolk volume, switch coffee/shake dairy to lower-fat lactose-free milk
Switch fish oil to algal omega-3 ≥1.5g EPA+DHA/day
Physician: discuss whether early ApoB-lowering is warranted given Lp(a) 49

root_attack_pillars.name: Pillar 2 — Refill iron stores AND find the leak
anchor_interventions: Physician iron workup BEFORE any high-dose iron (do not self-start)
Stool occult-blood + parasite/ova test (given rural Bihar + Thailand travel, never tested)
ENT review of the chronic one-sided block + Otrivin overuse (a likely nasal-bleeding source)
Reintroduce red meat 1-2x/week (mutton) for heme iron — he has no objection, just hasn't been eating it
Vitamin C 500mg WITH iron meals; move coffee + calcium (Recalmin) away from those meals by 1-2h

root_attack_pillars.name: Pillar 3 — Recover as hard as he trains
anchor_interventions: Extend sleep from ~6h to 7-7.5h (bed 9:45 latest; protect the 5:45 wake)
One true rest / active-recovery day per week (no MMA, no HIIT, no lifting)
10-min daily breathwork for the Bevel 80+ stress score
Convert ~2 weekly HIIT slots into Zone-2 (serves cardio goal + lowers load)

leading_principles: His stated goal is 'better cardio' — and steady cardio is ALSO the top lever for his HDL, his ApoB ratios, and his early-insulin signal. One change, three wins.
He currently does ~20 min of steady cardio a WEEK while training hard daily. That is the single biggest gap in an otherwise excellent regimen.
He is under-recovered, not under-trained. The goal is to redistribute load, not add to it.

weekly_structure.zone_2_detail: 3-4 sessions of 35-45 min at conversational pace (HR ~120-140). Cycle, incline treadmill, or shadow-boxing rounds kept aerobic. During Noida high-AQI months (Oct-Feb) keep these INDOORS / filtered air — relevant to his rhinitis and CV risk.
weekly_structure.hiit_note: Keep ONE true HIIT session/week (Saturday — his Monster-Zero slot). Reduce from current near-daily HIIT; the extra intensity is feeding under-recovery and possibly training hemolysis (iron).
weekly_structure.resistance_note: Keep his trainer-guided push/pull compound work — it is working (good progress, T 801). Just protect knees: no explosive/plyometric knee loading (his stated weak point).
weekly_structure.rest_day_detail: One full rest or active-recovery day (walk + mobility only). Non-negotiable — this is the recovery pillar.

twelve_week_plan.focus: Insert Zone-2 + claim the rest day
twelve_week_plan.detail: Add 2× Zone-2 (35 min). Designate Sunday as full rest. Do NOT add intensity — this block is about redistributing, not adding.
3× Zone-2/week (40 min). Trim HIIT to 1×/week. Keep 4× resistance + 3× MMA. Notice resting HR + how 'better cardio' starts to feel.
4× Zone-2 (45 min) on lighter weeks. Week 8 = deload (volume −40%). Progressive overload on compounds resumes week 9.
Hold the new structure. In the 48h before Day-90 retest: no heavy training (avoids transient CK/AST/hemolysis skew on the panel).

training.equipment_assumption: Commercial gym + MMA facility + cycle access
training.injury_accommodation: Knee — avoid deep plyometrics, heavy single-leg under fatigue; prioritise glute/hamstring balance; the daily 10-min mobility is knee-led.

recovery_sleep.rationale: He sleeps ~6h, wakes always groggy, snores on his back, and feels perpetually tired and under-recovered while training daily. Short sleep alone can lift HOMA-IR and blunt recovery and mood — it sits under three of his findings. Moving bedtime from 10:30 to 9:45 buys ~45-60 min with zero willpower cost.
recovery_sleep.wind_down_protocol: Screens off by 9:15 (he sometimes uses screens in bed). Magnesium glycinate (already taken) at 9:00. 10-min breathwork or journaling (he already journals — make it nightly). Room already ideal: dark, 19°C.
recovery_sleep.snoring_nasal_action: Side-sleeping (snores on back); and escalate the chronic one-sided nasal block to ENT — nasal obstruction is likely degrading his sleep quality and is a candidate cause of the 'always groggy'. Reduce Otrivin dependence under ENT guidance (rebound congestion risk).
recovery_sleep.AM_sunlight_note: 10 min daylight after waking (he gets only 2-3h daylight/day, mostly indoors) — anchors circadian rhythm, helps the groggy mornings and afternoon crash.
recovery_sleep.caffeine_cutoff: No caffeine after ~1pm; specifically drop the after-lunch coffee (protects 6→7h sleep AND iron absorption).
recovery_sleep.afternoon_crash_fix: The post-lunch crash is partly the heavy rice lunch + short sleep + the habit of relaxing after lunch. A 10-min post-lunch walk (not a recline) blunts the glucose dip and the grogginess.

leading_principles: Do NOT overhaul this — his diet is top-decile clean (zero fried, zero sugar, no late eating, minimal processed). Restriction is the wrong tool.
Two surgical changes only: (1) ADD soluble fibre without relying on vegetables he won't eat, (2) shift fat quality (less saturated) and ADD heme iron via red meat.
Everything must survive travel — his stated #1 obstacle.

daily_targets.eating_window_note: 6:15am-9pm ≈ 15h; the Tue/Thu IF days are good — consider nudging the first meal slightly later on non-training mornings to tighten the window, but this is optional, not a priority.

fibre_strategy_no_veg: Oats almost daily already — keep, add 1 tbsp chia + 1 tbsp ground flax stirred in (soluble fibre + ALA omega-3)
1 tsp-1 tbsp psyllium husk (isabgol) in water once daily — the single highest-leverage ApoB/LDL fibre move, no taste of vegetables
Dal up from 2x to 4-5x/week (also plant iron — pair with vitamin C, keep coffee away)
Keep banana + add berries (already likes blueberry); guava and apple-with-skin are easy veg-free fibre
Blended/soup routes for the few vegetables he'll tolerate — palak in dal, tomato/onion in gravies he already eats with chicken
fat_quality_shifts: Cut the leftover ghee use (he already reduced it) — use groundnut/mustard/olive oil, light hand
Halve egg-yolk volume on heavy-egg days (e.g., 2 whole + 3 whites instead of 5 whole) — keeps protein, cuts dietary saturated fat/cholesterol load; whites are unlimited
Switch the coffee/shake dairy to lower-fat lactose-free milk
Walnuts (already eats) + algal omega-3 cover the unsaturated side
iron_strategy: Reintroduce RED MEAT (mutton/lamb) 1-2x/week — best absorbable heme iron; he simply hasn't been eating it
Vitamin C 500mg (already owns) WITH the iron meal — or lemon on the meat/dal
Move coffee and the calcium-containing Recalmin-XT 1-2h away from iron meals (both block absorption)
This is the DIET arm only — therapeutic iron stays physician-gated until the cause workup is done

weekly_menu_sample.am: Whey isolate + 2 whole/3 white egg bhurji
weekly_menu_sample.lunch: Chicken + kala namak rice + dal + lemon (vit-C, iron)

weekly_menu_sample.lunch_2pm: Mutton 1× (heme iron) + rice + dal + lemon + vit-C

nutrition.lactose_rule: Isolate protein only (never concentrate); lactose-free milk only — already compliant.
nutrition.alcohol_caffeine_guidance: Alcohol is already a non-issue (2-3x/year). Caffeine: keep to AM, drop the post-lunch cup. Monster Zero pre-Saturday-HIIT is fine.

supplements.audit_first: His current stack is large and has redundancy. The job here is to PRUNE and RETIME more than to add.

stack_changes.change: CONSOLIDATE to one; keep multivitamin, drop the redundant B12 duplicators (discuss with physician — Recalmin also gives calcium)
stack_changes.reason: B12 >2000 and folate >24 from triple-stacking; pointless

stack_changes.change: Keep; take in the EVENING for sleep
stack_changes.reason: Serum Mg 1.98 (just under optimal) + sleep support

stack_changes.change: Keep — correct form for his lactose intolerance; never switch to concentrate

stack_changes.reason: Highest-leverage veg-free soluble fibre for ApoB/LDL

stack_changes.change: DO NOT self-start — physician-gated until cause workup done
stack_changes.reason: Bleeding signals + unscreened GI/parasite risk; masking a leak is dangerous

supplements.monthly_cost_note: Budget is unlimited per intake; net cost likely DROPS after pruning redundancies. Add only psyllium (~₹200/mo) + algal omega-3 (~₹900-1200/mo).
supplements.evidence_tags_summary: Most changes are E1-E2; the theme is prune + retime, not pile on.

mind_wellness.daily_practice: 10-min breathwork (physiological sigh or 4-7-8) — he meditates but does NO breathwork, and his Bevel stress sits 80+ daily. Breathwork is the fastest down-regulator for that number.
mind_wellness.weekly_practice: Keep meditation; make journaling nightly (he journals inconsistently) — useful given persistent low mood the last few months and relationship/money stress.
mind_wellness.relationship_money_stress_note: These are real, named stressors he can no longer wind down from. Not a supplement problem. The breathwork + protected sleep + one rest day are the levers; if low mood persists past a few more weeks, a check-in with a counsellor is reasonable and not a sign of weakness.
mind_wellness.screen_low_mood: Sub-clinical — monitor, not a clinical flag. Mind is a SUPPORTING domain here, paired with Recovery.

Claim Sunday as a full rest day

+ Psyllium daily + Vitamin C with iron meals + drop after-lunch coffee

ninety_day_habit_stack.coach_check_in_focus: Confirm retest logistics and the physician/ENT outcomes (iron cause found? lipid plan? nasal source?). Lock the same-lab same-slot retest so the deltas are real.

physician_referrals_required.reason: Lp(a) 49 mg/dL (genetic) + atherogenic ApoB 96 / LDL 135 / non-HDL 152
physician_referrals_required.ask: Confirm Lp(a) once (stable for life); ask about family premature-CVD (his is reassuring); discuss whether early ApoB-lowering is warranted at 25 given the inherited Lp(a).

physician_referrals_required.reason: Iron depletion (ferritin 7.5) with bleeding signals (gums, nasal mucus) in a heavy meat-eater
physician_referrals_required.ask: Work up the CAUSE before high-dose iron. Stool occult blood + ova/parasite (rural Bihar + Thailand travel, never tested). Choose supervised iron repletion + retest ferritin at 8-12 weeks.

physician_referrals_required.reason: Chronic one-sided nasal obstruction + near-daily Otrivin (rebound-congestion risk) + nasal bleeding + always-groggy/snoring
physician_referrals_required.ask: Assess for deviated septum / chronic rhinitis / rhinitis medicamentosa; this links his atopy, his nasal iron-loss source, and his poor sleep quality.

outcome_expectations.expectation: Resting HR down, sessions feel easier within 4-6 weeks of Zone-2; HDL 43→48+ and ApoB 96→<85 by Day 90
Improves as sleep goes 6→7h + iron repletes; cold hands ease; afternoon crash softens
Better with consistent 7h sleep, Zone-2, and lower stress load; brain fog less likely to recur
HOMA-IR 1.25→<1.0 as sleep, cardio and recovery improve

His strength training + MMA progress (T 801, good gains) — just redistribute load and add a rest day
Creatine, isolate whey, magnesium glycinate, lactose-free milk — all correct already
